name: NSW apprentice $100 car registration rebate
summary: First and second year NSW apprentices can get $100 back on the registration of a car in their own name.
key: First and second year apprentices may be eligible to receive a $100 rebate on their car registration.
who: Vehicle registered in NSW in the apprentice's name, renewed and paid after becoming an apprentice

source.label: NSW Department of Education: Financial assistance for apprentices and trainees

evidence.quote: First and second year apprentices may be eligible to receive a $100 rebate on their car registration.
To be eligible for the rebate, the vehicle must be registered in NSW in the name of an eligible apprentice
